places.quote: Did you ever lodge at Number Nine, Brig Place, Sir?

places.quote: endeavouring to lose the family amid the wilds and savage places of the City.
places.note: Capitalised reference to the City of London, used as a place of wandering.

places.quote: the Midshipman was abandoned by them all
places.note: Name of the Captain's shop or house; location not stated in passage.
